name: Motorno ulje i filtar ulja - kompletna izmjena
scope: oil+filter+washer; entire engine; no engine flush

name: Zamjena filtra zraka motora
scope: one filter

name: Zamjena filtra kabine
scope: standard cabin filter set; no special HEPA system

name: Zamjena filtra goriva
scope: one diesel fuel filter; no pump

name: Izmjena kočione tekućine
scope: standard passenger-car brake circuit; bleeding included

name: Izmjena rashladne tekućine motora
scope: engine circuit; no flush of contaminated system

name: Zupčasti remen, natezači i vodena pumpa
scope: belt kit+rollers+compatible pump+coolant; only if this engine has this arrangement

name: Zamjena kompleta svjećica
scope: all conventional spark plugs; number of cylinders modelled; no seized-plug extraction

name: Pomoćni remen i natezač
scope: one accessory drive belt+tensioner; no alternator

name: Izmjena ulja ručnog mjenjača
scope: drain/refill; ordinary manual gearbox; no differential service

name: Servis ulja automatskog mjenjača
scope: drain/refill+serviceable filter; not a guaranteed full fluid exchange; gearbox type must be confirmed

name: Prednje kočione pločice - par kotača
scope: pads for front axle; ordinary steel discs retained

name: Stražnje kočione pločice - par kotača
scope: pads for rear axle; ordinary steel discs retained

name: Prednji diskovi i pločice - par kotača
scope: two ordinary steel front discs+front pad set

name: Stražnji diskovi i pločice - par kotača
scope: two ordinary steel rear discs+rear pad set

name: Stražnje kočione pakne - par kotača
scope: rear shoes set; existing drums retained

name: Zamjena kompresora klime
scope: one conventional compressor+ordinary recharge/oil; no major contamination, condenser or evaporator repair

name: Zamjena ventilatora hladnjaka
scope: one fan assembly; not complete radiator

name: Servis klime R134a
scope: ordinary passenger-car charge up to 600 g; no leak repair

name: Servis klime R1234yf
scope: ordinary passenger-car charge; no leak repair; confirm charge quantity

name: Zamjena 12 V akumulatora
scope: one conventional lead-acid/EFB/AGM low-voltage battery; never traction battery or 16/48 V lithium system

name: Zamjena kompleta grijača dizela
scope: one ordinary glow plug per cylinder; no broken-plug extraction

name: Osnovno očitanje OBD kodova
scope: scan/readout only; not guaranteed root-cause diagnosis or unlimited troubleshooting

name: Zamjena elektropokretača
scope: one conventional starter; no belt starter generator

name: Zamjena alternatora
scope: one conventional alternator; not hybrid motor generator

name: Zamjena jednog turbopunjača
scope: one quality remanufactured turbo with standard seals/oil; no internal engine damage

name: Zamjena EGR ventila
scope: one EGR valve; cooler not included

name: Demontaža, čišćenje i montaža DPF-a
scope: serviceable intact filter; legal cleaning, not removal or ECU disabling

name: Zamjena DPF filtra
scope: one homologated replacement filter; no SCR/AdBlue system repair

name: Zamjena jedne dizelske brizgaljke
scope: one remanufactured compatible injector with ordinary coding; not the entire injector set

name: Zamjena jedne bobine
scope: one compatible coil; no full ignition harness

name: Zamjena jednog ležaja kotača
scope: one ordinary wheel bearing/hub; axle and exact side must be confirmed

name: Prednji amortizeri - par
scope: two conventional passive dampers+basic mounts+alignment; no air/adaptive suspension

name: Stražnji amortizeri - par
scope: two conventional passive dampers; no air/adaptive suspension

name: Zamjena kompleta spojke
scope: manual gearbox clutch kit; flywheel retained; no robotic/DCT clutch pack

name: Komplet spojke i dvomaseni zamašnjak
scope: manual clutch kit+dual-mass flywheel only if fitted

name: Zamjena vodene pumpe motora
scope: one conventional mechanically driven pump+coolant; excludes timing belt kit

name: Zamjena termostata motora
scope: one ordinary engine thermostat/housing and coolant top-up

name: Zamjena jedne lambda sonde
scope: one exhaust oxygen sensor; no catalytic converter
